subject.title: Add comprehensive AWS deployment guide (EC2, ECS, Lambda)

question: Which AWS deployment topologies should OpenClaw officially document and support, and should Lambda be declared unsupported for the persistent Gateway runtime?
rationale: A contributor cannot safely invent official persistence, exposure, IAM, secret-management, upgrade, or serverless support guarantees; these choices affect security posture and future support expectations.

options.title: Document bounded supported paths
options.body: Document EC2 or Lightsail plus one reviewed ECS/Fargate topology, and explicitly state that Lambda is unsupported unless a persistent Gateway architecture is approved later.

options.title: EC2 or Lightsail only
options.body: Limit the first guide to a hardened VM and Docker Compose path, leaving ECS/Fargate and Lambda explicitly out of scope.

options.title: External AWS guidance only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw docs provider-neutral and add reviewed links to AWS-maintained deployment guidance without promising AWS-specific operational support.

recommendation.title: Document bounded supported paths
recommendation.body: Document EC2 or Lightsail plus one reviewed ECS/Fargate topology, and explicitly state that Lambda is unsupported unless a persistent Gateway architecture is approved later.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored or maintained adjacent hosting documentation and already supplied the issue's concrete maintainer-side documentation plan.
